limitations: Derived numeric CSV of the already captured 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-20 MOA responses. It is not the original HTTP body; raw files remain separately retained by their exact SHA256.

Each commodity Entity identifies only a named original crop-code/type/market source series. Entity count is not a count of distinct physical goods; no canonical commodity identity, alias, qualification or freshness is accepted.

All eleven original response fields are copied as strings; the five original JSON number tokens preserve decimal spelling. Native value duplicates only the original 平均價; other price levels and kilograms are not extra goods.
Raw JSON pointers are zero-based. raw_record_ordinal is one-based within the original response array. Native CSV selection row numbers are separately recorded and exclude the CSV header.

Actual row acquired_at is the request finished_at. Dataset acquired_at is the latest acquisition among its constituent rows. Original published_at is null; the CSV published_at_json cell contains the literal JSON null representation. Trade dates and HTTP Date are not publication timestamps.

tax_basis=unknown and currency=unknown. The source document says only 元/公斤 for prices and 公斤 for transaction mass; do not infer TWD, tax-inclusive, exempt, or a price-tax basis from generic agricultural tax rules.

price_kind, market and contract remain unknown pending a directly applicable price/transaction-method definition. Source title 農產品交易行情 is retained without inventing a specific auction, quote, fee, spot/futures or weighting method.

assessment is the exact field label 平均價; assessment_formula remains unknown. Daily frequency describes the original one-day transaction-date observations; the two selected dates do not establish consecutive trading days or a day-over-day change.

All three original upper/middle/lower prices and the mean and quantity remain separate fields. Transaction quantity is kilograms, not cubic volume. No row or series was dropped because its identity or qualification remains unresolved.

Original API documentation EIR030 v1.2 issued 2025-05-05, retained PDF SHA256 7dbdd6b918c0826e459f9aed3eaf05026bb03722f7813a8c03df428ac1f2b903. Its older code table does not cover all current returned codes; that gap remains unresolved.

Source attribution: 農業部農糧署 / 農業資料開放平臺, 農產品交易行情; official metadata https://data.gov.tw/dataset/8066 and OGDL v1 https://data.gov.tw/license. Full request URLs, original clocks and raw digests are retained in every row.

No SourceRef has been fabricated or inserted. Later readings and goods declarations require actual saved dataset receipts plus identity/basis evidence. Custody compatibility is not qualification or freshness.
